exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: ________ she is beautiful, everybody hates her.
questions.explanation: 'Although' is followed by a clause with subject + verb. 'In spite of' needs a noun or Ving. 'Because' changes the meaning to cause. 'Although' ကို clause ရဲ့ ရှေ့မှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.explanation: 'In spite of' is followed by a noun. 'The noise' is a noun. 'Although' needs subject + verb. 'Because of' changes the meaning. 'In spite of' ကို noun ရဲ့ ရှေ့မှာ သုံးပါ။
